status.en: 18 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 44% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Sweida.
status.nb: 18 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 44 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Sweida.

summary.en: Syrian security forces again foiled a Hezbollah-linked bomb plot against the Homs oil refinery while Saudi Arabia and Syria signed a defence cooperation deal that includes $403 million in loans. A Lebanese border guard killed a Syrian woman and injured her child, and a landmine blast killed two soldiers in Daraa. Israeli airstrikes continued in southern Syria, and a cleric warned that Iran plans to disrupt oil supplies, while the EU expressed a security scare in Damascus and ISIS activity persisted after the U.S. withdrawal. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker avverget igjen et Hezbollah-tilknyttet bombemål mot Homs oljeraffineri mens Saudi-Arabia og Syria signerte en forsvarssamarbeidsavtale som inkluderer 403 millioner dollar i lån. En libanesisk grensevakt drepte en syrisk kvinne og såret hennes barn, og en landmineeksplosjon drepte to soldater i Daraa. Israelske luftangrep fortsatte i sørlige Syria, og en cleric advarte om at Iran planlegger å forstyrre oljeforsyningen, mens EU uttrykte en sikkerhetsbekymring i Damaskus og IS-aktivitet vedvarte etter USAs tilbaketrekning. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
